messages:
taylor: 3pm PT sync today to align vendor comms and marketplace timelines for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Need final availability windows + who owns co-announce. Can folks join? :wave:

alex: I can make 3pm. Quick clarifying q — are we doing a single coordinated announcement or staggered per vendor?

diego: Staggered is what partners prefer. Early signal from Nvidia: H200 in EU mid-Apr for select accounts, H100 replen shipments starting late Apr. B200 pilot expected early May. Gaudi vendor said limited pilot late May. MI300 cadence still OEM-dependent, tentatively June. All tentative until official partner confirmations.

maya: From product side we need the model->hardware compatibility matrix and recommended quant/profiles before marketplace listing goes live. Also need KV cache/latency notes for each SKU.

nora: Marketing note: we need 2 weeks lead time for joint blog + co-brand kit and any partner-approved quotes. If H100 in EU is mid-Apr, assets need to be ready by start of Apr. Can we get embargo windows?

taylor: Action list (quick): diego to lock windows with vendor contacts by EOD tomorrow; alex to prepare marketplace listing template + sample metadata; maya to draft compatibility checklist; nora to draft comms calendar and asset checklist; sam/legal to flag any co-marketing clauses early. Anyone own SI/on-prem image packaging?

diego: I'll ping SI leads and the partner-eng teams to confirm image packaging, driver versions, OFED/RDMA requirements. Also asking vendors for exact CUDA/rocm versions and firmware notes.

alex: Marketplace listing template (initial draft) — sharing quick snippet here for feedback: ```json
{ "region": "us-west-2", "gpu": "h100", "sku_status": "beta", "driver_version": "cuda-xyz", "availability_window": "2029-04-15 to 2029-04-30" }
```
I'll open a PR in eng-marketplace this afternoon.

integrations-bot: Reminder: SI onboarding meeting scheduled 2029-04-09 10:00 PT — added to calendar.

nora: :thumbsup: If partner PR windows are tighter than expected, propose a soft-launch / invite-only beta for dedicated customers to avoid public outages. Also collecting partner preferred logos and quote approvals — diego, can you chase?

sam: Legal: please route any co-marketing drafts and embargo dates to legal@redwood for review; also need to check partner NDA addendums for press mentions.

taylor: Great — thanks everyone. diego will confirm driver/CU details and embed points-of-contact; alex will post the marketplace PR; maya & nora will sync on compatibility vs comms. Follow-up quick check-in tomorrow 10am PT. If you can't make the call, drop updates in this thread. :rocket:
